aboutText.line1: Prenúncio forecasts where the Amazon will be cleared by July {year}.
aboutText.line2: We built it so enforcement can arrive before the clearing does.
aboutText.metric: The score is the mean of {b0} to {b1}.
aboutText.model: The map currently uses {name}, which combines gradient boosting with a U-Net. The forest is divided into {m} metre squares, the cells, and the model gives each one its chance of clearing in the year ahead.
aboutText.open: The code, the data and the benchmark are open. Anyone can submit a model.
aboutText.tested: To test it, we hid a year from the model and asked for its forecast. In {y}, {hit} of every {of} places it pointed to were cleared.
